scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The Siltglass Index remains unbalanced and the counterpoint loses this voice.
scenarios.journal_victory: Brakka countersealed the Siltglass Index as testimony 1 of Mireglass Counterpoint.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Brakka failed to secure the Siltglass Index testimony.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A horizontal crystal survey lens crosses a rooted meridian table inside a clear brass ring.
scenarios.label: Chapter II: Measure the Greenline
scenarios.description: Dovan refuses both a root monopoly and a glass monopoly by preserving the greenline beside his measure.
scenarios.status_hint: Break the exact local signature guard, then claim the guarded Greenline Lens Table before victory can resolve.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Only capped common stores and scoped testimony cross this boundary; hero progression, spells, artifacts, and units remain local.
scenarios.briefing: The first mire testimony reaches a survey line roots have bent out of every chart. Dovan must measure it without cutting away what made it alive.
scenarios.intel: Rootgate's signature Survey stands immediately before the lens table and must fall to open the final tile.
scenarios.stakes: A perfect measure that destroys its subject is only a cleaner form of erasure.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Dovan preserves the living greenline beside his exact crystal measure. The bounded testimony travels to the next commander.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The Greenline Lens Table remains unbalanced and the counterpoint loses this voice.
scenarios.journal_victory: Dovan countersealed the Greenline Lens Table as testimony 2 of Mireglass Counterpoint.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Dovan failed to secure the Greenline Lens Table testimony.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A circular woven-reed frame holds one amber votive flame and three pale jaw charms.
scenarios.label: Chapter III: Temper the Reedflame
scenarios.description: Nix opens Highwater's vigil and tempers its flame around Reedbarrow's older promise.
scenarios.status_hint: Break the exact local signature guard, then claim the guarded Reedflame Votive Frame before victory can resolve.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Only capped common stores and scoped testimony cross this boundary; hero progression, spells, artifacts, and units remain local.
scenarios.briefing: Highwater calls every old ferry vow kindling. Nix must open the vigil and prove a new flame can guard an older promise rather than consume it.
scenarios.intel: The Reedflame Vigil blocks the frame at the east bank while two screens hold the approaches.
scenarios.stakes: If every accord begins by burning its predecessor, no counterpoint survives one generation.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Nix keeps the old ferry vow visible inside the newly tempered flame. The bounded testimony travels to the next commander.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The Reedflame Votive Frame remains unbalanced and the counterpoint loses this voice.
scenarios.journal_victory: Nix countersealed the Reedflame Votive Frame as testimony 3 of Mireglass Counterpoint.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Nix failed to secure the Reedflame Votive Frame testimony.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: Three pale mineral arches suspend a dusk-blue prism above a black mirrored basin.
scenarios.label: Chapter IV: Tune the Ossuary
scenarios.description: Ilyr turns Bellwake's battery and gives its drowned reflection a line inside the prism cadence.
scenarios.status_hint: Break the exact local signature guard, then claim the guarded Ossuary Prism Choir before victory can resolve.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Only capped common stores and scoped testimony cross this boundary; hero progression, spells, artifacts, and units remain local.
scenarios.briefing: A drowned mirror can still answer if the battery stops firing through it. Ilyr must turn the guns and tune what remains rather than overwrite it.
scenarios.intel: Bellwake's Ossuary Battery blocks the choir while a second high guard protects the older prism yard.
scenarios.stakes: A cadence that admits only clear voices cannot carry the coast's dead or the mire's dark record.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Ilyr tunes the drowned reflection without making it a Sunvault echo. The bounded testimony travels to the next commander.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The Ossuary Prism Choir remains unbalanced and the counterpoint loses this voice.
scenarios.journal_victory: Ilyr countersealed the Ossuary Prism Choir as testimony 4 of Mireglass Counterpoint.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Ilyr failed to secure the Ossuary Prism Choir testimony.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A luminous mushroom bell hangs over a dark resonance bowl between curled reedwood legs.
scenarios.label: Chapter V: Sound the Glowcap
scenarios.description: Edda secures the croft watch and adds its low fungal resonance beneath the four inherited testimonies.
scenarios.status_hint: Break the exact local signature guard, then claim the guarded Glowcap Echo Bell before victory can resolve.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Only capped common stores and scoped testimony cross this boundary; hero progression, spells, artifacts, and units remain local.
scenarios.briefing: The counterpoint has measures, vows, and drowned voices but no sustaining low note. Edda must win the Glowcap Croft and sound the bowl behind it.
scenarios.intel: The exact Croft Watch blocks the bell at the eastern edge; three spellward screens protect its route.
scenarios.stakes: Without a ground note, the bright cadence becomes another signal that cannot survive fog or distance.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Edda sounds a low glowcap refrain beneath the inherited glass cadence. The bounded testimony travels to the next commander.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The Glowcap Echo Bell remains unbalanced and the counterpoint loses this voice.
scenarios.journal_victory: Edda countersealed the Glowcap Echo Bell as testimony 5 of Mireglass Counterpoint.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Edda failed to secure the Glowcap Echo Bell testimony.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A forked mast balances a clear diamond kite, a pale counter-vane, and two hanging weights.
scenarios.label: Chapter VI: Balance the Countermast
scenarios.description: Essa clears the final eyrie and balances all six independently won voices into one long-range accord.
scenarios.status_hint: Break the exact local signature guard, then claim the guarded Kite-Signal Countermast before victory can resolve.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Only capped common stores and scoped testimony cross this boundary; hero progression, spells, artifacts, and units remain local.
scenarios.briefing: The six voices remain separate until a mast can carry them without placing one above the rest. Essa must clear the eyrie and balance the final signal.
scenarios.intel: The Kite-Signal Eyrie Watch blocks the countermast directly; three eastern screens relay hostile marks.
scenarios.stakes: If the final signal flattens its sources, the campaign ends with a slogan rather than a counterpoint.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Essa balances mire-dark and prism-clear testimony into one signal with neither side above the other. The bounded testimony travels to the next commander.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The Kite-Signal Countermast remains unbalanced and the counterpoint loses this voice.
scenarios.journal_victory: Essa countersealed the Kite-Signal Countermast as testimony 6 of Mireglass Counterpoint.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Essa failed to secure the Kite-Signal Countermast testimony.

items.name: The Rootbound Canticles
items.description: Six Thornwake commanders bind iron, salt, cinder, coppice, orchard, and mountain testimony into one living road-song without erasing who carried each verse.
items.summary: A six-chapter Thornwake campaign that brings every remaining faction hero into campaign play through their own production battlefield and signature encounter.
items.region: Furnace Rail, Drowned Orchard, Cinder Writ, Greenbranch, Orchard Levy, and Switchback Reaches
items.emblem_alt_text: Six unequal living roots braid into an open ring around a luminous seed, carrying a rail rivet, seed bell, graft coal, copse whistle, orchard stone, and switchback cairn.
items.arc_goal: Win six exact frontier testimonies and stack them as one traversable covenant while every commander's personal strength remains local to the road that earned it.
items.completion_summary: The six testimonies remain distinct, but their shared cadence now carries Thornwake from scorched rail to the highest switchback.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A blackened furnace rail and rivet are held in a narrow braided-root ring.
scenarios.label: Chapter I: Bend the Ironroot
scenarios.description: Halen cools Clauseworks' rail furnace and bends its broken line into the first traversable verse.
scenarios.status_hint: Break the Furnace Railbreak to record the Ironroot testimony before completing the board.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Only capped common stores and the prior scoped testimony cross each boundary; hero progression, spells, artifacts, units, and rares remain local.
scenarios.briefing: A road-song cannot begin by pretending the iron line never existed. Halen must break its furnace claim, cool the rail, and teach it a living turn.
scenarios.intel: Two foreclosure screens protect the Furnace Railbreak while Clauseworks Depot sustains pressure from the east.
scenarios.stakes: If Thornwake can only destroy the roads it inherits, the canticle will end at its first border.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Halen bends the cooled rail into an ironroot verse that another commander can follow.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The furnace keeps the first road rigid and the canticle finds no opening measure.
scenarios.journal_victory: Halen recorded the Ironroot testimony as verse 1 of the Rootbound Canticles.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Halen failed to record the Ironroot testimony.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A pale cracked seed bell hangs inside a salt-dark root arch and braided ring.
scenarios.label: Chapter II: Hear the Saltseed
scenarios.description: Veyra stills the drowned bell without discarding the salt-mark that proves what the orchard survived.
scenarios.status_hint: Break the Drowned Orchard to record the Saltseed testimony before completing the board.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Only capped common stores and the prior scoped testimony cross each boundary; hero progression, spells, artifacts, units, and rares remain local.
scenarios.briefing: The Ironroot verse reaches an orchard whose buried bell keeps salting every new seed. Veyra must still it without hiding the wound beneath fresh leaves.
scenarios.intel: Two drowned processions screen the signature seed bell while Fogchart Mooring presses the southern road.
scenarios.stakes: A covenant that records only recovery teaches its heirs to repeat every forgotten flood.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Veyra preserves one salt-marked seed note beside Halen's cooled iron.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The drowned bell drowns the second verse before a living orchard can answer.
scenarios.journal_victory: Veyra recorded the Saltseed testimony as verse 2 of the Rootbound Canticles.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Veyra failed to record the Saltseed testimony.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: Living root arms cradle a split brazier and one banked coal inside a braided green ring.
scenarios.label: Chapter III: Bank the Cinder Graft
scenarios.description: Merek breaks the cinder writ and grafts one disciplined coal into a root that can outlive its charter.
scenarios.status_hint: Break the Cinder Writ to record the Cinder Graft testimony before completing the board.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Only capped common stores and the prior scoped testimony cross each boundary; hero progression, spells, artifacts, units, and rares remain local.
scenarios.briefing: Highwater claims every useful flame must carry its ownership mark. Merek must break the cinder writ and prove heat can be tended without being possessed.
scenarios.intel: The Cinder Writ commands the eastern brazier behind two turncoat screens and an older orchard levy watch.
scenarios.stakes: If every shared fire remains somebody's charter, the road-song will fracture at the first winter camp.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Merek banks a living coal inside the third verse without carrying Highwater's writ onward.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The cinder writ stamps out the third verse and keeps the road's warmth under seal.
scenarios.journal_victory: Merek recorded the Cinder Graft testimony as verse 3 of the Rootbound Canticles.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Merek failed to record the Cinder Graft testimony.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A leaf-roofed coppice platform stands between two tall hollow whistles inside a braided-root ring.
scenarios.label: Chapter IV: Sound the Copse
scenarios.description: Osmund clears the Greenbranch watch and lets the intact coppice sound its own fourth verse.
scenarios.status_hint: Clear the Greenbranch Copse Watch to record the Copse Whistle testimony before completing the board.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Only capped common stores and the prior scoped testimony cross each boundary; hero progression, spells, artifacts, units, and rares remain local.
scenarios.briefing: Three hard-won materials have entered the canticle, but none yet speaks with the voice of an undamaged place. Osmund must clear the watch without flattening its living instrument.
scenarios.intel: The Greenbranch Copse Watch holds the raised platform while two foreclosure screens close the western approaches.
scenarios.stakes: If every new verse requires a ruin first, Thornwake will learn to mistake damage for authorship.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Osmund sounds the fourth verse through branches left standing and roots left named.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The watch keeps the coppice silent and the canticle learns nothing from a place still whole.
scenarios.journal_victory: Osmund recorded the Copse Whistle testimony as verse 4 of the Rootbound Canticles.

scenarios.stakes: A meridian calibrated to a hidden furnace will look precise until its first instrument ruptures.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Thalen leaves the black crescent chipped and draws the first white-gold segment through the exposed disagreement.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The shutter keeps one convenient reading and no later sightline can know which pressure it inherited.
scenarios.journal_victory: Thalen calibrated the Foundry Eclipse Gauge as segment 1 of the Broken Meridian.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Thalen failed to calibrate the first Meridian segment.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: Three pale cliff spires linked by rope bridges carry sheltered nests, a central wind vane, hooked gold finials, and one clean white-gold sightline.
scenarios.label: Chapter II: Hold the Cliffhawk Sightline
scenarios.description: Renn clears the roost watch and spans three unequal heights without pretending the wind leaves them level.
scenarios.chapter_title: A Straight Ray Crosses Unequal Ground
scenarios.status_hint: Clear the Cliffhawk Roost Watch to calibrate the second segment before completing the board.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Only capped common stores and the prior exact proof cross between commanders; progression, armies, spells, artifacts, and rares remain local.
scenarios.briefing: The exposed gauge points toward three cliff towers whose bridges drift under different winds. Renn must clear the watch and align their sight vanes without forcing the heights into a false level.
scenarios.intel: Two Graftbound screens guard the heights while Graftroot Caravan anchors the enemy claim beyond the roost.
scenarios.stakes: If the meridian ignores elevation and wind, its straight line will be accurate only on paper.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Renn threads one ray through three unequal spires and records every correction beside the bridge that required it.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The roost keeps its broken sightline and the foundry segment ends below an unmeasured sky.
scenarios.journal_victory: Renn calibrated the Cliffhawk Sightline as segment 2 of the Broken Meridian.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Renn failed to calibrate the second Meridian segment.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A ringed stone sump holds blue-violet crystals beneath a crooked echo horn and two guard walls while a broken white-gold ray realigns through the cluster.
scenarios.label: Chapter III: Relay the Crystal Sump
scenarios.description: Calis secures the sump watch and lets the crystal cluster realign the inherited ray without erasing either earlier break.
scenarios.chapter_title: Let the Crystal Record the Correction
scenarios.status_hint: Secure the Crystal Sump Watch to calibrate the final segment and complete the Broken Meridian.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Only capped common stores and the prior exact proof cross between commanders; progression, armies, spells, artifacts, and rares remain local.
scenarios.briefing: Two segments reach the crystal circuit carrying visible corrections from furnace and height. Calis must secure the sump and tune its relay to preserve those breaks while aligning the outgoing ray.
scenarios.intel: Four Graftbound relays cover the 13x8 circuit while Graftroot Caravan and the sump watch divide the route under escalating pressure.
scenarios.stakes: A crystal that smooths every incoming fault creates brightness, not truth.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Calis sends the ray onward aligned but visibly jointed, completing a meridian that can explain every correction it made.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The sump scatters the inherited line and the first two calibrations remain accurate fragments without a public measure.
scenarios.journal_victory: Calis calibrated the Crystal Sump Relay as segment 3 and completed the Broken Meridian.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Calis failed to complete the Broken Meridian.

items.name: The Six Roads Relay
items.description: Six commanders carry one frontier dispatch across bog chains, redline ledgers, drowned bells, thorn roads, and charter locks without surrendering their own commands.
items.summary: A six-chapter relay campaign that turns six rival-road victories into one bounded cross-command expedition.
items.region: The Rival-Road Circuit
items.emblem_alt_text: Six materially different roads converge on a bronze relay ring around one pale compass flame.
items.arc_goal: Open six rival roads, preserve each commander's exact testimony, and lodge their combined dispatch at Rainwrit before any faction can rewrite the route alone.
items.completion_summary: Six separate commands keep their own victories while one common dispatch proves the complete frontier road from Hollowreed to Rainwrit.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A heavy reedwood relay drum is bound by chain beside a long hooked road key.
scenarios.label: Chapter I: Sound the Chainboom
scenarios.description: Kessa opens the Graftwake cordon and strikes the first road testimony into a chain-bound relay drum.
scenarios.status_hint: Open Kessa's three root seals, take Briarwheel, and sound the relay road.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Exports only capped common stores and Kessa's opened-road testimony; her growth, spells, artifacts, army, and rare stores remain local.
scenarios.briefing: Six rivals have each closed one part of the frontier road. Kessa must break the Graftwake cordon and give the neutral dispatch a cadence the next commander can recognize.
scenarios.intel: Three fixed root fronts and a southern counterstroke protect Briarwheel while the optional witness watch offers a harder detour.
scenarios.stakes: Without a first beat, every later commander receives an unsigned route that can be dismissed as another faction's claim.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Kessa leaves her chainboom at Hollowreed and sends a sealed rhythm into Pell's redline reckoning.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The cordon swallows the dispatch before the relay can establish a common cadence.
scenarios.journal_victory: Kessa opened Graftwake and sounded the first relay testimony.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Kessa failed to give the Six Roads Relay its opening beat.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A red sealed road ledger and pale river quill stand above one blue current.
scenarios.label: Chapter II: Record the Redline
scenarios.description: Pell translates Kessa's drum cadence into a road ledger that survives Blackbell's pressure clauses.
scenarios.status_hint: Break the three pressure fronts, claim Blackbell, and enter the relay in Pell's reedscript.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports capped common stores and the opened-road testimony, then exports Pell's exact redline record without personal power.
scenarios.briefing: Kessa's cadence proves the road was opened, but not where it leads. Pell must carry it through Blackbell and write a reckoning that daylight glass can measure.
scenarios.intel: The redline closes through three iron clauses while Mirrorstep calibrators threaten the southern proof rail.
scenarios.stakes: If the cadence is not written against Blackbell's pressure, the next lens will measure a rhythm without a route.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Pell seals the redline beside Kessa's cadence and forwards both records to Meridian.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: Blackbell stamps its own toll over the first testimony and breaks the relay's chain of custody.
scenarios.journal_victory: Pell recorded the second relay testimony across the Blackbell redline.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Pell failed to make the relay cadence legible.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A many-faceted sun lens rests directly above a small bronze relay bell.
scenarios.label: Chapter III: Refract the Fenbell
scenarios.description: Ilyr turns the inherited ledger through a faceted daylight lens and fixes its drowned bearings.
scenarios.status_hint: Align the three fen fronts, claim Nightglass, and preserve the refraction.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports only common stores and Pell's redline record, then exports Ilyr's fixed bearing while all commander-bound state stays local.
scenarios.briefing: Pell's ledger reaches Meridian with every distance recorded but each direction drowned. Ilyr must clear Nightglass and refract the record into a bearing Renn can sound along the coast.
scenarios.intel: Three fen bearings disagree beneath drowned chains, and a drum-circle counterstroke can reopen the southern meridian.
scenarios.stakes: A route with distance but no bearing will send the relay around Nightglass forever.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Ilyr fixes the third testimony in daylight glass and sends its exact angle toward Pale Sounding.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The drowned bearings turn Pell's careful distances into a closed circle.
scenarios.journal_victory: Ilyr refracted the third relay testimony through the Fenbell line.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Ilyr failed to give the relay record a stable bearing.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A pale hanging cliff bell sounds beside a tall asymmetrical mirror shard.
scenarios.label: Chapter IV: Mark the Last Sounding
scenarios.description: Renn carries Ilyr's fixed angle through ghost tide and gives the route a coastal sounding.
scenarios.status_hint: Recover three coastal marks, claim Pale Sounding, and ring the relay bell.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports capped stores and Ilyr's bearing, then exports Renn's sounding without transferring either hero's progression, spellbook, or relics.
scenarios.briefing: A daylight angle cannot warn a road hidden under fog. Renn must cross Pale Sounding, recover three erased marks, and ring a bearing Halen can follow beneath the canopy.
scenarios.intel: Ghost-tide fronts cover the coast while a Tollglass crew works behind the southern daylight mark.
scenarios.stakes: If the bearing cannot be heard through fog, the living road will grow toward the brightest false opening.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Renn rings the fourth testimony across the pale cliffs and passes its cadence into Crownroot.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The ghost tide erases the route's voice and leaves only a silent angle on glass.
scenarios.journal_victory: Renn marked the fourth relay testimony at the Last Sounding.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Renn failed to make the relay bearing audible.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A living thorn cartwheel closes around a bright eight-rayed dawn spark.
scenarios.label: Chapter V: Grow the Daybreak Road
scenarios.description: Halen braids Renn's sounding into a shaded living road that can carry the dispatch beneath hostile lenses.
scenarios.status_hint: Cool the three sunlines, claim Halo Spire, and grow the relay road toward Rainwrit.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports only bounded stores and Renn's sounding, then exports Halen's living road record without commander-bound state.
scenarios.briefing: Renn's bell reaches Crownroot, but open sunlight would expose every courier. Halen must cool Halo Spire's three lines and grow a shaded road for the final petition.
scenarios.intel: Three solar fronts divide the canopy and a Glasswing sortie can sever the southern wheel ruts.
scenarios.stakes: Without roots, five testimonies remain accurate but cannot reach the charter court together.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Halen grows the fifth testimony into a living road and sends its last cart toward Briarwheel.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: Halo Spire burns the relay out of the canopy before the final petition can travel.
scenarios.journal_victory: Halen rooted the fifth relay testimony through the Daybreak Tangle.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Halen failed to give the relay a living road.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A pollen-filled glass petition vial is locked beside one long green witness leaf.
scenarios.label: Chapter VI: Lodge the Lockglass Appeal
scenarios.description: Osmund carries all five testimonies down Halen's living road and lodges the complete frontier appeal at Rainwrit.
scenarios.status_hint: Open the three charter locks, claim Rainwrit, and lodge the complete relay dispatch.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports the final bounded stores and living-road testimony; no earlier commander progression, spell, artifact, army, or rare resource enters Osmund's command.
scenarios.briefing: The dispatch reaches Briarwheel with beat, record, bearing, sounding, and road intact. Osmund must open Rainwrit's three locks and lodge all six testimonies without letting one overwrite the rest.
scenarios.intel: Archive wardens, a Lockglass citation field, and the Frostwharf writ host guard the court while a charter counterstroke closes the greenroad behind him.
scenarios.stakes: If Rainwrit accepts only one faction's account, every prior victory becomes evidence for a new monopoly instead of a common road.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Rainwrit accepts six separate testimonies under one lockglass seal, and the rival-road circuit becomes a shared frontier route.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The court divides the dispatch into six contradictory claims and seals every road again.
scenarios.journal_victory: Osmund lodged the sixth testimony and completed the Six Roads Relay.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Osmund failed to lodge the complete relay at Rainwrit.

items.name: The Six Unbound Oaths
items.description: Six independent companies answer one another across the frontier, proving that a common road can be defended without turning its free companies into another lord's levy.
items.summary: A six-chapter concord campaign about earning and carrying six distinct neutral-company oaths while every commander keeps an independent command.
items.region: The Unbound Frontier Ring
items.emblem_alt_text: Six materially different oath tokens remain separate around one open bronze concord ring.
items.arc_goal: Win six free companies by their own terms, carry each exact oath forward, and open a shared frontier route whose members remain unbound.
items.completion_summary: Six commanders and twelve neutral companies hold one open road under six separate oaths, with no faction permitted to turn the concord into a levy.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A broad bear paw holds an iron-banded hedge gate inside a round field of leaves.
scenarios.label: Chapter I: Open the Hedgecourt
scenarios.description: Torren breaks two charter screens and earns the Brambleback companies' first oath without claiming their gate as faction property.
scenarios.status_hint: Clear both rival screens, claim Brambleback Hedgecourt, and muster both resident companies.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Exports only capped common stores and the Hedgecourt oath; Torren's growth, spellbook, relics, army, and rare stores remain local.
scenarios.briefing: Rival collectors have marked Brambleback Hedgecourt as an unowned levy yard. Torren must clear their screens, defeat the resident watch on its own ground, and invite both companies into a concord they can still refuse.
scenarios.intel: The route contains two rival screens and one visible dwelling guard; the Hedgecourt can only be claimed after all three fronts are clear.
scenarios.stakes: If the first company is conscripted rather than asked, every later oath will be another chain with a kinder name.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: The Hedgecourt opens by choice, and Torren sends its paw-mark oath onward without taking its gate key.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The rival charter stamps the Hedgecourt as property before the concord gains its first free voice.
scenarios.journal_victory: Torren earned the Brambleback Hedgecourt oath and kept the company unbound.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Torren failed to open the first free-company oath.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A squat bronze marsh bell hangs over concentric ripples between two reed clumps.
scenarios.label: Chapter II: Answer the Bellfen
scenarios.description: Brakka carries the paw-mark into Mireglass water and earns a second oath that can be heard without repeating the first.
scenarios.chapter_title: Let the Marsh Answer in Its Own Voice
scenarios.status_hint: Break both claim screens, claim Mireglass Bellfen, and assemble its two resident companies.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports capped common stores and the Hedgecourt oath, then exports only the Bellfen oath; no commander-bound state crosses the marsh.
scenarios.briefing: The Hedgecourt oath reaches Brakka as a mark, not an order. Mireglass Bellfen will join only if its own watch is met and its two companies hear no foreign command in the invitation.
scenarios.intel: Three battles cover the bell-water route; claiming the dwelling releases both neutral companies directly into Brakka's army bar.
scenarios.stakes: A concord that merely echoes its first member cannot represent the marsh companies it asks to defend.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Bellfen answers beside the paw mark, adding a second oath without drowning the first.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The collectors silence Bellfen and present the first oath as authority it never granted.
scenarios.journal_victory: Brakka earned the Mireglass Bellfen oath as the concord's second independent voice.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Brakka failed to let Bellfen answer freely.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A tall uneven stone cairn supports a crosswind vane beneath a small rayed sun disk.
scenarios.label: Chapter III: Set the Windcairn
scenarios.description: Essa turns two inherited oaths toward open sky and earns a third company witness that points rather than commands.
scenarios.status_hint: Clear the approach, claim Windcairn Wayhouse, and muster both independent route companies.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports only the prior oath and capped common stores, then exports the Windcairn witness with all personal power isolated.
scenarios.briefing: Two oaths can agree and still go nowhere. Essa must clear the Wayhouse route and ask its porters and slingers to set a direction that neither hedge nor fen could dictate alone.
scenarios.intel: Rival screens hold the lower path while the resident watch controls the cairn; both recruited companies are required for victory.
scenarios.stakes: Without a neutral bearing, the concord can be turned toward whichever faction speaks loudest.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Windcairn points beyond both earlier claims, giving the concord a road no member owns.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The cairn is reset as a faction boundary and the first two oaths lose their common direction.
scenarios.journal_victory: Essa earned the Windcairn Wayhouse oath and set the free road's bearing.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Essa failed to set an independent bearing for the concord.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: Two forked living branches cross over a six-spoked wooden cartwheel with leaf clusters at their tips.
scenarios.label: Chapter IV: Grow the Greenbranch
scenarios.description: Halen carries the cairn's direction into living cover and earns the Greenward oath by making room for its own growth.
scenarios.chapter_title: Let the Road Grow Without a Master
scenarios.status_hint: Break the rival screens, claim Sapwhistle Greenward, and assemble both resident companies.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports the preceding witness and capped stores, then exports only the Greenward oath; no prior commander enters Halen's command.
scenarios.briefing: The open bearing crosses land that refuses straight lines. Halen must clear the Greenward without pruning it into a faction road and invite both resident companies to shape the passage themselves.
scenarios.intel: Two approach battles guard the cart track and one dwelling watch holds the fork; the claim recruits both required companies.
scenarios.stakes: A free road that cannot bend around living communities will become a conquest route by habit.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Greenbranch grows around the inherited bearing and sends a fourth oath down a road with room to change.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The route is cut straight through Greenward and the concord loses the freedom it was meant to protect.
scenarios.journal_victory: Halen earned the Sapwhistle Greenward oath and gave the concord a living road.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Halen failed to let the free road grow on local terms.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A tall asymmetrical iron shield carries three deep diagonal scars beside a square-headed broken-yard hammer.
scenarios.label: Chapter V: Hold the Scarshield
scenarios.description: Kuld Varn tests the living road under pressure and earns a fifth oath from companies that measure agreements by what survives impact.
scenarios.chapter_title: Prove the Concord Can Take a Blow
scenarios.status_hint: Clear the claimants, take Scarshield Breakyard, and muster both veteran companies.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports only capped stores and the Greenward oath, then exports the Scarshield proof without transferring personal state or rare stores.
scenarios.briefing: Four oaths describe a free road, but none prove it can endure a concerted claim. Kuld Varn must clear Breakyard and let its veterans judge whether the concord holds when struck.
scenarios.intel: The route presents two rival screens and a visible yard watch; the final claim places both neutral companies under the active hero without altering prior armies.
scenarios.stakes: If the concord survives only while unchallenged, its freedom is a pause rather than a pact.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Scarshield takes the blow and remains unclaimed, adding a fifth oath tempered by refusal.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: Breakyard is stamped into a levy chain and the living road closes behind its first real test.
scenarios.journal_victory: Kuld Varn earned the Scarshield Breakyard oath and proved the concord under pressure.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Kuld Varn failed the concord's first hard impact.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A tall timber harbor mast bears a caged flame above a curling pale mist wake and dark foundation rocks.
scenarios.label: Chapter VI: Light the Flaremast
scenarios.description: Cela carries five exact oaths through fog and earns the final pilotage oath that makes the shared road visible without closing it.
scenarios.chapter_title: Show the Road, Leave the Ring Open
scenarios.status_hint: Clear both rival screens, claim Flaremast Pilotage, and assemble the final two companies.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports the Scarshield oath and final capped common stores; no earlier progression, spellbook, relic, army, or rare resource enters Cela's command.
scenarios.briefing: Five oaths reach the coast intact, but fog can still turn a shared road into a private channel. Cela must clear Flaremast Pilotage and earn a final beacon that guides newcomers without sealing the concord behind them.
scenarios.intel: Two claimant screens and one pilotage watch cover the last route; victory requires both resident companies in Cela's live army after the dwelling claim.
scenarios.stakes: A closed ring would preserve today's members by betraying every free company that might answer tomorrow.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Flaremast lights above six separate seals, and the concord keeps one deliberate gap for the next unbound oath.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The coast disappears behind a private charter and five hard-won oaths end at a locked harbor.
scenarios.journal_victory: Cela earned the Flaremast Pilotage oath and completed an open Six Unbound Oaths concord.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Cela failed to light the concord's open road.

items.name: The Charterless Compact
items.description: Six commanders excluded from every patron's field charter pass one unsigned ledger through six different trials until it can stand as common frontier law.
items.summary: A six-chapter anthology campaign joining six factions and six production mechanics through bounded witness handoff and isolated command.
items.region: The Unsigned Frontier Circuit
items.emblem_alt_text: An open weathered field ledger is encircled by six materially different witness tabs while its center remains deliberately unsigned.
items.arc_goal: Prove an unsigned frontier record through commission, defense, garrison, regalia, territorial control, and named opposition without transferring personal command between its six witnesses.
items.completion_title: The Ledger Answers to No Patron
items.completion_summary: Six commanders have entered six independent proofs into one field compact whose resources can be shared but whose heroes, armies, artifacts, spells, and rare claims remain their own.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A crescent tide hook carries a blank slate above one sharply curling dark wave.
scenarios.label: Chapter I: Lift the Blank Slate
scenarios.description: Olan Tidehook opens a field ledger that no court has signed by breaking Reedwake's commission line and taking its hostile mooring.
scenarios.status_hint: Break the Reedwake commission, claim the opposing town, and record the first charterless witness.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Exports only a capped share of common stores and Olan's blank-slate witness; his army, growth, spellbook, artifacts, and rare stores remain local.
scenarios.briefing: A waterlogged slate reaches Olan with every patron's seal scraped away. Reedwake's collectors call it invalid. He must defeat their commission, take the hostile mooring, and prove a command can enter the record without inheriting a court's authority.
scenarios.intel: Three field fronts protect the commission road; the central writ must fall before the blank slate can be entered into the ledger.
scenarios.stakes: If the first witness is bought by a patron, every later chapter will be another private order disguised as common law.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Olan lifts the first blank slate from Reedwake and sends it inland with no patron's mark attached.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The collectors sink the unsigned slate and restore Reedwake's old chain of custody.
scenarios.journal_victory: Olan entered Reedwake as the first charterless witness.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Olan failed to establish an unsigned field record.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A double assay gauge balances between two unequal angular anvils on one central iron standard.
scenarios.label: Chapter II: Hold the Double Assay
scenarios.description: Kestra Blackgauge subjects the unsigned witness to two defended holds and twelve days of measured pressure.
scenarios.status_hint: Keep both assay holds, break all three fronts, and survive through Day 12.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports only Olan's witness and capped common stores, then exports Kestra's pressure proof without transferring either commander.
scenarios.briefing: An unsigned record is easy to dismiss as soft metal. Kestra must hold both assay towns, break the three pressure fronts, and keep the slate intact until the twelfth-day reading proves it cannot be bent by siege or debt.
scenarios.intel: The assay is a timed defense: both holds and all three hostile fronts must remain settled when the final gauge is read.
scenarios.stakes: A witness that fails under pressure will be rewritten by the first court rich enough to squeeze it.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Both gauges return true, and Kestra stamps the blank slate with a pressure proof rather than a proprietor's seal.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: One assay buckles, letting the old ledgers call the charterless witness counterfeit.
scenarios.journal_victory: Kestra proved the second witness across the Double Assay.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Kestra failed to keep the unsigned record true under pressure.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: Three differently sized pale prisms rise behind a compact iron-banded wooden gate bar.
scenarios.label: Chapter III: Staff the Three Prisms
scenarios.description: Aven Sevenfold converts the pressure-tested slate into an exact garrison warrant and deliberately staffs Meridian's three companies.
scenarios.chapter_title: Turn Proof Into a Defensible Order
scenarios.status_hint: Recover all three warrant companies, transfer the exact required stacks into Meridian, and clear their guards.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports capped stores and Kestra's proof, then exports only Aven's exact garrison measure; no army or personal state crosses chapters.
scenarios.briefing: Proof alone cannot hold a gate. Aven must recover three separated warrant companies, carry them home, and place their exact strengths into Meridian's garrison so the common record becomes an order that can be checked and defended.
scenarios.intel: The warrant recruits enter Aven's field army first; victory requires deliberate town-stack transfers into the specified home garrison.
scenarios.stakes: If the compact cannot name who holds the wall and in what strength, its independence will collapse at the first night alarm.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Three prisms agree on the same garrison measure, giving the charterless record an exact defensive clause.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The companies remain scattered and the unsigned record proves unable to hold a single gate.
scenarios.journal_victory: Aven entered the Three-Prism garrison measure as the third witness.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Aven failed to turn the compact's proof into a defensible order.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A long-eared fenhound mask grips three materially different regalia tokens in an open jaw ring.
scenarios.label: Chapter IV: Wear the Fenhound Witness
scenarios.description: Rhask Reedcaller recovers and equips the complete Fenhound Pursuit regalia without allowing the inherited pieces to replace his own command.
scenarios.chapter_title: Bind Authority to a Responsible Bearer
scenarios.status_hint: Win the three guardian battles, recover all set pieces, and equip the complete Fenhound Pursuit regalia.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports only Aven's measure and capped stores, then exports Rhask's regalia witness while every equipped piece remains in its home chapter.
scenarios.briefing: A defensible order still needs a bearer the frontier can recognize. Rhask must recover the Fenhound Pursuit pieces, equip the complete regalia, and show that visible authority can answer to the compact without becoming inherited ownership.
scenarios.intel: Two pieces lie behind field guards and the last comes from the guarded reliquary; inventory possession is insufficient until the full set is equipped.
scenarios.stakes: If regalia owns the bearer instead of identifying responsibility, the compact will become another hereditary chain.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Rhask wears all three pieces, gives the compact a visible witness, then leaves the regalia with Fenhound rather than carrying it onward.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The scattered regalia becomes proof that the compact cannot bind authority to accountable command.
scenarios.journal_victory: Rhask added the equipped Fenhound witness without exporting its power.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Rhask failed to assemble a responsible bearer for the compact.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A rooted crossbow bolt supports a forked cloth standard whose two unequal wings remain visibly separate.
scenarios.label: Chapter V: Root the Border Standards
scenarios.description: Bryn Boltroot clears three cordons and turns three separated standards into one rooted frontier witness.
scenarios.chapter_title: Give the Compact Ground Without Giving It a Master
scenarios.status_hint: Break all three border cordons, control the three standards, and keep Briarwheel under player command.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports Rhask's witness and capped stores, then exports only Bryn's rooted standard record; all heroes, armies, artifacts, and rare stores remain isolated.
scenarios.briefing: Four witnesses can still be dismissed as traveling words. Bryn must clear the three cordons, hold Briarwheel, and root three standards far enough apart that no single banner can pretend to own the ground between them.
scenarios.intel: Each standard is guarded by a distinct cordon and all three control positions are required alongside the home-town hold.
scenarios.stakes: Without ground, the compact can be honored in every hall and ignored on every road.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Three standards take root without merging into one crown, and Bryn sends their common bearing toward the Tollmoon road.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The cordons close and the compact remains a promise with nowhere to stand.
scenarios.journal_victory: Bryn rooted the fifth charterless witness across Briarwheel's border.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Bryn failed to give the compact independent ground.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A dark powder quill crosses a crescent toll hook beneath one narrow two-tailed field pennant.
scenarios.label: Chapter VI: Seal the Tollmoon Compact
scenarios.description: Maela Powderwrit carries five witnesses into Orrik Tollreaver's command line, turns all three banners, and defeats the rival claimant in person.
scenarios.chapter_title: Defend the Common Record Against a Named Claim
scenarios.status_hint: Break the approach companies, control all three command banners, capture the rival town, and defeat Orrik Tollreaver.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports only Bryn's witness and capped common stores; no prior commander power enters Maela's final company.
scenarios.briefing: The five witnesses reach Tollmoon just as Orrik Tollreaver names the entire compact an unpaid claim. Maela must break his approach companies, turn all three command banners, take the rival town, and defeat the named claimant without borrowing authority from any earlier hero.
scenarios.intel: The final route combines three persistent control positions, an enemy-town capture, two approach battles, and Orrik's roster-backed rival company.
scenarios.stakes: If a named claimant can seize the ledger at its final hearing, six independent proofs will become one more toll schedule.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Maela crosses powder quill and Tollmoon hook over six independent witnesses, sealing a compact no patron owns.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: Orrik enters the six witnesses as collateral and closes the frontier ledger under his own name.
scenarios.journal_victory: Maela defeated Orrik and sealed The Charterless Compact.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Maela failed to defend the common record against its final named claim.

items.name: The Six Sealed Companies
items.description: Six commanders reopen six erased veteran rolls and pass their independently witnessed company seals around the frontier until one open ledger can recognize them all without owning any of them.
items.summary: A six-chapter cross-faction campaign about restoring every missing veteran company through guarded musters, exact rosters, and bounded witness handoff.
items.region: The Lastwatch Muster Circuit
items.emblem_alt_text: An open iron-bound muster ledger carries six materially distinct frontier seals around a deliberately empty central clasp.
items.arc_goal: Recover six guarded veteran grounds, assemble every erased production company, and enter six independent muster seals into one common ledger without carrying commander power between chapters.
items.completion_summary: The Lastwatch bell has entered six independently recovered companies into one open frontier ledger; all eighteen missing veteran identities now have both a live muster and a shared campaign history.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A forked ember charter pennant rises above a compact iron rollhouse brazier.
scenarios.label: Chapter I: Raise the Ash-Charter Roll
scenarios.description: Torren reopens the rain-black rollhouse and enters Embercourt's recovered veteran grades as the first sealed company.
scenarios.status_hint: Break the three screens, claim Ash-Charter Rollhouse, and assemble every required Embercourt veteran.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Exports only Torren's muster-seal witness and a capped share of common stores; his company, growth, spells, artifacts, and embergrain remain local.
scenarios.briefing: Six veteran rolls have been struck from the frontier ledger at once. Torren must force open Ash-Charter Rollhouse, recall its scattered companies, and send the first independently witnessed seal down the circuit before the erased rolls become accepted law.
scenarios.intel: Three hostile companies cover the western road, southern approach, and rollhouse gate. The seal is entered only after the exact veteran company is assembled.
scenarios.stakes: Without the first recovered roll, every later muster can be dismissed as an isolated local claim.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Torren raises the forked ash pennant and sends the first sealed company roll into the frontier circuit.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The rollhouse remains shuttered and the first missing company is written off as already lost.
scenarios.journal_victory: Torren entered the Ash-Charter veteran roll as the first sealed witness.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Torren failed to recall the first sealed company.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A taut fen chain ring encloses one hide drum and a small marsh lantern.
scenarios.label: Chapter II: Bind the Gorefen Chain
scenarios.description: Kessa Chainboom binds ferry lashers and Gorefen shock companies into a second muster seal that cannot be separated from its living roster.
scenarios.status_hint: Clear the ring approaches, claim Gorefen Chain Ring, and assemble both missing Mireclaw veteran grades.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports only Torren's witness and capped common stores, then exports Kessa's chain-bound seal without transferring either commander.
scenarios.briefing: The first seal reaches the fen with its clasp cut but its witness intact. Kessa must tighten Gorefen's slack chain ring, recover the ferry and shock companies named on it, and prove the circuit records living formations rather than empty heraldry.
scenarios.intel: Sunvault screens hold the dry approaches. The chain ring remains blocked until its guard falls and both missing companies answer Kessa's field roll.
scenarios.stakes: A ledger of symbols without soldiers would let any court claim the recovered companies exist only on paper.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: The hide drum sounds through a taut chain ring, carrying the second sealed company onward.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The chain stays slack and Gorefen's erased veterans remain scattered among the channels.
scenarios.journal_victory: Kessa bound the Gorefen chain as the second sealed witness.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Kessa failed to make the second company roll answer.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A split ivory drill prism stands between asymmetric mirror fins above a small sun dial.
scenarios.label: Chapter III: Align the Daybreak Prism
scenarios.description: Ilyr Glassmarshal aligns mirror duelists and a Daybreak colossus under one split prism so neither reflection can counterfeit the roster.
scenarios.chapter_title: Prove the Roll in Two Reflections
scenarios.status_hint: Defeat the three Thornwake screens, open the drill prism, and assemble both exact Sunvault veteran identities.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports only Kessa's chain witness and capped common stores, then exports Ilyr's aligned seal while all personal state remains local.
scenarios.briefing: Two recovered seals can still be called mutually convenient stories. Ilyr must open the split Daybreak drill prism and align its missing duelists and colossus in two independent reflections before adding a third witness to the circuit.
scenarios.intel: Thornwake cordons occupy both approaches and the prism court. Victory requires the exact companies, not substitute strength or a captured landmark alone.
scenarios.stakes: If the third roll cannot survive mirrored inspection, the whole circuit can be broken by one forged roster.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Both mirror fins agree on the assembled company, and Ilyr dispatches the third seal without a disputed line.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The prism remains folded and the veteran roll fractures into incompatible reflections.
scenarios.journal_victory: Ilyr aligned the Daybreak company as the third sealed witness.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Ilyr failed to prove the veteran roll in both reflections.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: Five living boughs curl around a seed shield and a glowing root heart.
scenarios.label: Chapter IV: Root the Five Boughs
scenarios.description: Silsa Bramblehound wakes five muster boughs and recalls Thornwake's complete missing company span from scouts to Worldroot Bastion.
scenarios.chapter_title: Recall Every Grade of the Living Roll
scenarios.status_hint: Clear all three foundry screens, claim the grove, and assemble all five required Thornwake veteran grades.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports Ilyr's aligned witness and capped stores, then exports only Silsa's rooted seal; no army, growth, spell, artifact, or rare graft crosses chapters.
scenarios.briefing: The circuit reaches a grove whose roll was not erased with ink but put to sleep at the roots. Silsa must wake all five boughs and call every missing grade, from the smallest pollenhook company to the Worldroot Bastion itself.
scenarios.intel: Brasshollow interdictors have divided the grove from its outer companies. The fourth witness is valid only when all five identities stand in Silsa's field army.
scenarios.stakes: A compact that records only its largest formations will abandon the scouts and tenders who make every veteran line possible.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Five boughs flower around one living roll, and Silsa sends the rooted fourth seal toward the foundry road.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The grove stays dormant and Thornwake's missing grades remain separate, nameless roots.
scenarios.journal_victory: Silsa rooted all five company grades as the fourth sealed witness.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Silsa failed to wake the complete living roll.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: Three unequal brass pressure gauges rise above a black foundry bell hammer.
scenarios.label: Chapter V: Certify the Three Gauges
scenarios.description: Selka Pitmarshal restores three independent assay gauges and certifies the recovered Brasshollow company under field pressure.
scenarios.status_hint: Break the charter screens, open Three-Gauge Chapter Foundry, and assemble all three missing Brasshollow veterans.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports Silsa's rooted witness and capped stores, then exports Selka's pressure certificate while every commander's personal state stays isolated.
scenarios.briefing: Four seals name companies; the fifth must prove they can still meet a hard measure. Selka must relight Three-Gauge Chapter Foundry, restore its erased veteran grades, and obtain three independent readings before the final sounding.
scenarios.intel: Embercourt companies hold the assay roads and foundry gate. The gauges certify only the exact quenchspool, gaugefire, and Foundry Saint roll.
scenarios.stakes: Without a measured field strength, the compact could preserve proud names while sending hollow companies to the wall.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Three unequal gauges return one true reading, and Selka stamps the fifth company seal under pressure.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The foundry stays cold and the recovered roster fails its first common assay.
scenarios.journal_victory: Selka certified the Three-Gauge company as the fifth sealed witness.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Selka failed to measure the recovered roll under pressure.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A pale sounding bell hangs above a hooked fog keel and torn white-blue sailcloth.
scenarios.label: Chapter VI: Sound the Fog-Keel Lastwatch
scenarios.description: Jessa Keelwarden reopens Lastwatch Mooring, recalls its missing crews, and sounds the final bell over all six independently witnessed company seals.
scenarios.chapter_title: Enter Six Companies in One Open Ledger
scenarios.status_hint: Defeat the three Mireclaw screens, claim Lastwatch Mooring, and assemble every required Veilmourn veteran before the final sounding.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Imports only Selka's certificate and capped common stores; no prior commander, army, progression, spellbook, artifact, or rare claim enters Jessa's company.
scenarios.briefing: Five seals reach the pale harbor while the last roll is being lowered into fog. Jessa must clear Fog-Keel Lastwatch, recall its boarders, reavers, and leviathan, then sound a bell that enters all six witnesses into one open ledger without making any company property of another.
scenarios.intel: Mireclaw screens cover both harbor roads and the mooring guard. The final sounding requires the exact Veilmourn company and control of Lastwatch itself.
scenarios.stakes: If the sixth roll vanishes, the circuit remains an unfinished chain that every hostile court can contest one seal at a time.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: The pale bell sounds over six distinct seals, restoring every erased veteran company to the common frontier ledger.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: Lastwatch falls silent and the five recovered seals scatter without a final common entry.
scenarios.journal_victory: Jessa sounded Fog-Keel Lastwatch and completed The Six Sealed Companies.
scenarios.journal_defeat: Jessa failed to enter the six company seals into one open ledger.

items.name: The Wild Atlas Accord
items.description: Six commanders carry one open field atlas through six living habitats, proving routes in ash, fen, broken light, moving roots, buried pressure, and the sounding deep without turning any road into ownership.
items.summary: A six-chapter cross-faction campaign that turns six frontier habitat expeditions into one bounded witness chain.
items.region: The Six Living Bearings
items.emblem_alt_text: An open asymmetrical field atlas carries six materially distinct clasps around a pale compass-seed flame.
items.arc_goal: Secure six living habitats, recruit each exact frontier creature, and pass only its witnessed bearing plus capped common stores to the next independent commander.
items.completion_summary: The Gloambell sounds through six distinct clasps. Every route remains open to future correction and none becomes the property of the commander who witnessed it.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A split basalt chimney and four ember vanes curve around an empty bronze censer.
scenarios.label: Chapter I: Enter the Censerwing Bearing
scenarios.description: Lyra clears Censerwing Updraft Roost and records the atlas's first living bearing in ember and wind.
scenarios.chapter_title: Open the Atlas in Rising Ash
scenarios.status_hint: Break all three watches, claim the roost, recruit Cindervane Censerwings, and capture the opposing seat.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Only the chapter witness and capped common stores cross this handoff; commander growth, army stacks, spells, artifacts, and rare resources remain local.
scenarios.briefing: A field atlas with six empty clasps has surfaced on the frontier. Lyra must prove its first route is more than an old survey by securing the updraft roost and entering a living Censerwing bearing.
scenarios.intel: Three habitat watches divide the road from the roost. The witness is entered only when a Censerwing joins Lyra's company.
scenarios.stakes: Without a living first bearing, the remaining pages are only decorative guesses.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Ember vanes turn above the open atlas, fixing its first bearing in living flight.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The ash route closes and the atlas keeps its first clasp empty.
scenarios.journal_victory: Ember vanes turn above the open atlas, fixing its first bearing in living flight.
scenarios.journal_defeat: The ash route closes and the atlas keeps its first clasp empty.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: Two unequal crescent shells rise around a dark mirror basin rooted into a reed-wrapped landing.
scenarios.label: Chapter II: Read the Fenmirror Bearing
scenarios.description: Tarn secures Fenmirror Shell Basin and reads the second bearing where no dry road survives.
scenarios.chapter_title: Find a Route in Dark Water
scenarios.status_hint: Clear the three watches, claim the basin, recruit Fenmirror Gallowshells, and take the frontier seat.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Only the chapter witness and capped common stores cross this handoff; commander growth, army stacks, spells, artifacts, and rare resources remain local.
scenarios.briefing: The first clasp points into water that reflects no reliable sky. Tarn must reach the shell basin, muster its Gallowshells, and teach the atlas to hold a route that shifts with the fen.
scenarios.intel: The mirror basin remains guarded after the outer watches fall. A living Gallowshell witness is the only stable measure.
scenarios.stakes: An atlas that records only dry roads abandons half the frontier before the accord begins.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Two unequal shells hold one dark reflection, and the fen route settles into the atlas.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The basin clouds over and the second bearing dissolves among the reeds.
scenarios.journal_victory: Two unequal shells hold one dark reflection, and the fen route settles into the atlas.
scenarios.journal_defeat: The basin clouds over and the second bearing dissolves among the reeds.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: Two asymmetric prism sails and three crystal keels frame an offset oval lens.
scenarios.label: Chapter III: Align the Prismwake Bearing
scenarios.description: Neral aligns Prismwake Refraction Shelf and fixes a third route through glare, mirage, and divided light.
scenarios.chapter_title: Carry the Road Through Broken Light
scenarios.status_hint: Defeat all three watches, claim the shelf, recruit Prismwake Raylings, and capture the opposing seat.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Only the chapter witness and capped common stores cross this handoff; commander growth, army stacks, spells, artifacts, and rare resources remain local.
scenarios.briefing: The wet bearing reaches a crossing that appears in three places at once. Neral must open the refraction shelf and use its Raylings to align a route no single reflection can counterfeit.
scenarios.intel: The last watch blocks both the habitat and the true line through the glasswind. Recruitment completes the alignment.
scenarios.stakes: If glare can invent a road, every later atlas entry can be disputed as illusion.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Two prism sails agree around one offset lens, and the third bearing holds through broken light.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The crossing fractures into mirages and the atlas loses its eastern line.
scenarios.journal_victory: Two prism sails agree around one offset lens, and the third bearing holds through broken light.
scenarios.journal_defeat: The crossing fractures into mirages and the atlas loses its eastern line.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: Unequal living-root antlers surround a hollow seed dais and three hanging seed lanterns.
scenarios.label: Chapter IV: Root the Knotstag Bearing
scenarios.description: Bryn Boltroot secures Knotstag Root-Court and gives the atlas a fourth bearing that grows with the land.
scenarios.chapter_title: Let the Atlas Remember Living Ground
scenarios.status_hint: Clear the watches, claim the root-court, recruit Rootcrown Knotstags, and capture the hostile seat.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Only the chapter witness and capped common stores cross this handoff; commander growth, army stacks, spells, artifacts, and rare resources remain local.
scenarios.briefing: Three fixed bearings cannot describe a road whose soil moves. Bryn must open the root-court, muster its Knotstags, and root a living circuit into the atlas without pinning the grove in place.
scenarios.intel: The court lies behind three hostile fronts. Its antler gates answer only when a Rootcrown company accepts the route.
scenarios.stakes: A map that kills change to preserve accuracy becomes obsolete the moment it is sealed.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Unequal root antlers flower around the fourth clasp, and the atlas learns to remember change.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The living road closes beneath old growth and the fourth page remains rootless.
scenarios.journal_victory: Unequal root antlers flower around the fourth clasp, and the atlas learns to remember change.
scenarios.journal_defeat: The living road closes beneath old growth and the fourth page remains rootless.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: Three brass pressure rings carry a diagonal drill rail, two blank gauges, and a red relief valve.
scenarios.label: Chapter V: Measure the Gaugecoil Bearing
scenarios.description: Harro Debtrune opens Gaugecoil Pressure Burrow and measures a fifth route through stone and pressure.
scenarios.chapter_title: Cut a Road Beneath the Surface
scenarios.status_hint: Break three burrow watches, claim the habitat, recruit Gaugecoil Orewyrms, and seize the opposing seat.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Only the chapter witness and capped common stores cross this handoff; commander growth, army stacks, spells, artifacts, and rare resources remain local.
scenarios.briefing: The rooted page ends at bare rock, but pressure marks a road beneath it. Harro must open the burrow, recruit its Orewyrms, and certify a route by three unequal gauges instead of inherited claims.
scenarios.intel: The final watch guards the drill line and habitat together. The gauges settle only after a living Orewyrm joins the expedition.
scenarios.stakes: Without a measured under-road, the accord can be cut wherever mountains hide the surface.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Three pressure rings settle around the fifth clasp, fixing a road beneath the visible world.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The gauges climb into danger and the under-road collapses outside the atlas.
scenarios.journal_victory: Three pressure rings settle around the fifth clasp, fixing a road beneath the visible world.
scenarios.journal_defeat: The gauges climb into danger and the under-road collapses outside the atlas.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A drowned bell hangs beneath a tilted whalebone arch above two tideglass pools and a hooked keel stair.
scenarios.label: Chapter VI: Sound the Gloambell Bearing
scenarios.description: Cela Mist-Corsair secures Gloambell Sounding Deep and sounds all six bearings as an open frontier accord.
scenarios.chapter_title: Leave the Atlas Open to Every Horizon
scenarios.status_hint: Defeat Tova Rootwright's three watches, claim the deep, recruit Gloambell Wake-Mantas, and capture the final seat.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Only the chapter witness and capped common stores cross this handoff; commander growth, army stacks, spells, artifacts, and rare resources remain local.
scenarios.briefing: Five bearings reach the coast but none can name the road beyond sight. Cela must pass Tova Rootwright's living cordon, open Gloambell Sounding Deep, and let its Wake-Mantas carry the atlas beyond every fixed horizon.
scenarios.intel: Tova commands the final habitat watch from the rootward road. The drowned bell sounds only for a living Wake-Manta witness.
scenarios.stakes: A closed atlas becomes a border. An open atlas can remain an accord between travelers who refuse to own one another's roads.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: The drowned bell sounds through six unequal clasps, leaving the completed atlas open to every frontier horizon.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The last sounding fails and five hard-won routes close into separate claims.
scenarios.journal_victory: The drowned bell sounds through six unequal clasps, leaving the completed atlas open to every frontier horizon.
scenarios.journal_defeat: The last sounding fails and five hard-won routes close into separate claims.

items.name: The Uncrowned Circuit
items.description: Six commanders prove six open seats through live town construction, apex recruitment, field victories, and witnessed claims, closing a circuit whose center deliberately remains uncrowned.
items.summary: A six-chapter cross-faction campaign joining real Tier-7 town building and muster play to six large sovereign roads.
items.region: The Six Open Seats
items.emblem_alt_text: Six materially distinct clasps form an open bronze circuit around an empty center.
items.arc_goal: Build each town's apex project, recruit its exact Tier-7 witness, claim its open field seat, and carry only a bounded common-store record to the next independent commander.
items.completion_summary: Every spoke has a built authority and living witness. The circuit closes around an empty center so no victory can become a permanent inherited crown.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A black sluice-stone seat stands beneath an open broken brass ring beside a white ember bowl.
scenarios.label: Chapter I: Open the Charter Seat
scenarios.description: Maela Powderwrit opens Cinderlock's charter seat by building its apex bastion and fielding a living Charter Colossus.
scenarios.status_hint: Clear three fronts, build the apex project, muster one Charter Colossus, claim the open seat, and take the rival town.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Only the witnessed claim and capped common stores cross the handoff; commander growth, army stacks, spells, artifacts, and rare resources remain local.
scenarios.briefing: Cinderlock's claimants have polished an empty seat while leaving its charter road undefended. Maela must turn ceremony into authority by building the bastion, mustering its Colossus, and breaking every rival writ on the road.
scenarios.intel: The third claimant front guards the open seat. The chapter witness is entered only after the exact apex unit joins the commander's live army.
scenarios.stakes: An empty seat without built authority is pageantry; authority without a living witness is only a ledger claim.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Cinderlock's open ring holds no crown; the Colossus answers a charter proven by work.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The road closes around an empty claim and the circuit loses this spoke.
scenarios.journal_victory: Cinderlock's open ring holds no crown; the Colossus answers a charter proven by work.
scenarios.journal_defeat: The open seat remains unproven.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: Unequal drowned antlers frame a bogstone seat, hide drum, reed scales, and peat lantern.
scenarios.label: Chapter II: Sound the Antler Verdict
scenarios.description: Pell Reedscript opens Murkward's tribunal by raising the Antler Pit and mustering its Drowned Sovereign.
scenarios.chapter_title: Let the Ford Judge Its Claim
scenarios.status_hint: Clear three fronts, build the apex project, muster one Drowned Antler Sovereign, claim the open seat, and take the rival town.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Only the witnessed claim and capped common stores cross the handoff; commander growth, army stacks, spells, artifacts, and rare resources remain local.
scenarios.briefing: A dry-road court has declared Murkward unfit to judge its own crossing. Pell must build the antler pit, field the ford's apex witness, and make the tribunal answer to those who can actually hold the drowned road.
scenarios.intel: The third claimant front guards the open seat. The chapter witness is entered only after the exact apex unit joins the commander's live army.
scenarios.stakes: An empty seat without built authority is pageantry; authority without a living witness is only a ledger claim.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: The drum answers beneath unequal antlers, and Murkward's verdict belongs to no distant crown.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The road closes around an empty claim and the circuit loses this spoke.
scenarios.journal_victory: The drum answers beneath unequal antlers, and Murkward's verdict belongs to no distant crown.
scenarios.journal_defeat: The open seat remains unproven.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: An ivory-gold seat hangs in an offset prism halo crossed by three calibration needles.
scenarios.label: Chapter III: Align the Empty Matrix
scenarios.description: Aven Sevenfold completes Dawnmirror's matrix and fields its Daybreak Colossus as proof of calibrated authority.
scenarios.chapter_title: Calibrate a Seat Without a Crown
scenarios.status_hint: Clear three fronts, build the apex project, muster one Daybreak Colossus, claim the open seat, and take the rival town.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Only the witnessed claim and capped common stores cross the handoff; commander growth, army stacks, spells, artifacts, and rare resources remain local.
scenarios.briefing: Dawnmirror's old claim is only reflected light. Aven must build the true matrix, muster the Daybreak Colossus, and align an authority that can be measured instead of inherited.
scenarios.intel: The third claimant front guards the open seat. The chapter witness is entered only after the exact apex unit joins the commander's live army.
scenarios.stakes: An empty seat without built authority is pageantry; authority without a living witness is only a ledger claim.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Three needles agree around an open halo, and Dawnmirror's authority survives its own measurement.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The road closes around an empty claim and the circuit loses this spoke.
scenarios.journal_victory: Three needles agree around an open halo, and Dawnmirror's authority survives its own measurement.
scenarios.journal_defeat: The open seat remains unproven.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A living root seat grows beneath unequal flowering boughs, two seed lamps, and a graft spool.
scenarios.label: Chapter IV: Grow the Living Dais
scenarios.description: Veyra Seedseer grows the Worldroot Gate and fields its Bastion before the caravan's living dais.
scenarios.chapter_title: Prove a Claim That Can Change
scenarios.status_hint: Clear three fronts, build the apex project, muster one Worldroot Bastion, claim the open seat, and take the rival town.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Only the witnessed claim and capped common stores cross the handoff; commander growth, army stacks, spells, artifacts, and rare resources remain local.
scenarios.briefing: A fixed throne cannot govern a town that migrates with the seasons. Veyra must grow the Worldroot Gate, muster its Bastion, and prove that Graftroot can change without surrendering its road.
scenarios.intel: The third claimant front guards the open seat. The chapter witness is entered only after the exact apex unit joins the commander's live army.
scenarios.stakes: An empty seat without built authority is pageantry; authority without a living witness is only a ledger claim.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: The living dais flowers without a crown, rooted by a Bastion that moves when the caravan moves.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The road closes around an empty claim and the circuit loses this spoke.
scenarios.journal_victory: The living dais flowers without a crown, rooted by a Bastion that moves when the caravan moves.
scenarios.journal_defeat: The open seat remains unproven.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: A basalt and brass assay seat carries three gauges, an open clamp, and a red relief valve.
scenarios.label: Chapter V: Assay the Saintless Seat
scenarios.description: Kestra Blackgauge charters Orevein's apex hall and fields a Foundry Saint before the open assay seat.
scenarios.chapter_title: Make Every Claim Bear Its Cost
scenarios.status_hint: Clear three fronts, build the apex project, muster one Foundry Saint, claim the open seat, and take the rival town.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Only the witnessed claim and capped common stores cross the handoff; commander growth, army stacks, spells, artifacts, and rare resources remain local.
scenarios.briefing: Orevein's ledgers name a saint before anyone has paid the work's true cost. Kestra must build the charter hall, muster the Foundry Saint, and put the entire claim under pressure.
scenarios.intel: The third claimant front guards the open seat. The chapter witness is entered only after the exact apex unit joins the commander's live army.
scenarios.stakes: An empty seat without built authority is pageantry; authority without a living witness is only a ledger claim.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: Three gauges settle below redline; Orevein recognizes the work and leaves the crown clamp open.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The road closes around an empty claim and the circuit loses this spoke.
scenarios.journal_victory: Three gauges settle below redline; Orevein recognizes the work and leaves the crown clamp open.
scenarios.journal_defeat: The open seat remains unproven.

scenarios.seal_alt_text: Whalebone and blackwood frame an empty tide chair beneath shroud sails, a drowned bell, and three chimes.
scenarios.label: Chapter VI: Sound the Empty Chair
scenarios.description: Jessa Keelwarden completes Bellwake's sounding and fields its Fogbound Leviathan to close the six-road circuit.
scenarios.chapter_title: Close the Circuit Without Closing the Crown
scenarios.status_hint: Clear three fronts, build the apex project, muster one Fogbound Leviathan, claim the open seat, and take the rival town.
scenarios.carryover_summary: Only the witnessed claim and capped common stores cross the handoff; commander growth, army stacks, spells, artifacts, and rare resources remain local.
scenarios.briefing: Five open seats now answer to witnessed work. Jessa must complete the Leviathan Sounding, call its apex witness from the fog, and close the circuit without placing a crown at its center.
scenarios.intel: The third claimant front guards the open seat. The chapter witness is entered only after the exact apex unit joins the commander's live army.
scenarios.stakes: An empty seat without built authority is pageantry; authority without a living witness is only a ledger claim.
scenarios.aftermath_victory: The drowned bell sounds through six open claims; the circuit closes while its center remains free.
scenarios.aftermath_defeat: The road closes around an empty claim and the circuit loses this spoke.
scenarios.journal_victory: The drowned bell sounds through six open claims; the circuit closes while its center remains free.
scenarios.journal_defeat: The open seat remains unproven.
